title: Stadtwerke Achim AG
description: stadtwerke-achim.de arbeiten-in-achim.de emobil-stadtwerke-achim.de  Stadtwerke Achim AG is a municipal energy utility in Achim, Lower Saxony, founded in 1910 as Gaswerk Achim AG and serving around 45000 customers across Achim, Oyten, Ottersberg and Langwedel. Owned 95 percent by the city of Achim and 5 percent by the municipality of Ottersberg, it is led by board member Sven Feht and employs about 100 people. It runs a 1170 km electricity grid, 985 km of gas pipelines and a district heating network fed by its own combined heat and power plant on Friedrichstrasse operating since 1983. Revenue reached 72 million euro in 2025 with a record 4 million euro profit, recovering after the 2023 gas crisis, and reliability is excellent at just 1.33 minutes of power outage per customer per year. Beyond electricity, gas and heat it offers photovoltaics with BayWa re, heat pumps on 15 year leases, EV charging with Mennekes and energy consulting, and it maintains 4500 LED street lights in Achim.
